archetype: High-Energy Event Kiosk & Tactical Operator Dashboard
overview: SnapBooth is an enterprise-grade photo booth application (LumaBooth-style) engineered for event professionals running weddings, birthday parties, and corporate activations. It encompasses three distinct visual surfaces: Surface A (Fullscreen Touch Kiosk), Surface B (Tactical Operator Admin Dashboard), and Surface C (Public Mobile Guest Gallery).

kiosk.name: Surface A: Guest-Facing Kiosk
kiosk.target_display: 1080x1920 Portrait (primary booth mode) AND 1920x1080 Landscape responsive flex layout
ux_constraints: Strictly zero browser chrome & zero viewport scrolling (overflow-hidden h-screen w-screen)
Minimum touch target size: 64px x 64px (padding p-4 to p-6 for all interactive touch targets)
Hidden exit gesture: Triple-tap top-left corner (invisible 80x80px area) triggers PIN pad modal
Auto-idle return: 60s inactivity timer auto-resets session to attract screen with soft toast warning at 10s
Mute toggle support: Respect per-event audio mute setting while triggering countdown beeps, shutter flash sound, and print completion chime
Dual-language toggle: Hot switchable English and Bahasa Indonesia (id) strings on header/attract overlay

screens.idle_attract: Fullscreen animated photo mosaic or looping hero backdrop + large pulsing pill 'TAP TO START' (min height 72px) + Event logo overlay + language switcher pill (EN | ID)
screens.template_picker: Responsive card grid (2x2 or 2x3) displaying high-res thumbnail previews of print layouts (e.g. 4x6 3-pose strip, 2x6 dual strip, 4-pose grid) with active highlight ring
screens.filter_picker: Live camera feed canvas backdrop + horizontal bottom swipeable filter carousel with real-time SVG filter preview thumbnails (Original, Vintage Warm, B&W Glam, Cyber Neon, Soft Pastel, Retro Film)
screens.countdown_capture: Fullscreen mirrored camera canvas + central giant numeric countdown (5..4..3..2..1 with spring scale-up animation) + bold 'GET READY!' prompt + high-intensity full screen white flash backdrop on shutter stroke
screens.review_retake: Side-by-side or stacked preview of captured shots with prominent touch action controls: 'RETAKE SHOT #' (warning orange accent) vs 'KEEP & PRINT' (emerald glow CTA)
screens.processing: Full-overlay ambient particle ring / processing spinner + progress bar ('Compositing your print template...', 'Applying filter...', 'Generating QR code...')
screens.print_qr_delivery: Split view screen: High-res rendered final print card on left/top + massive scannable QR Code (/g/{token}) with 'SCAN TO DOWNLOAD TO YOUR PHONE' on right/bottom + big 'PRINT AGAIN' & 'DONE' action buttons

admin.name: Surface B: Operator Admin Dashboard
admin.target_display: Desktop and tablet web browsers (password & JWT protected, 30-day session)
ux_constraints: Tactical command-center high density layout with sticky sidebar and quick-action top bar
Live status indicators for Camera status (Webcam / Mock DSLR), Printer status (Ready / Printing / Out of paper / Offline), and Booth Bridge connection
Visual slot template editor with drag-and-resize photo frames over custom PNG overlay images
Direct Reprint / Re-send QR / Delete / ZIP Download gallery management
Kiosk Launcher direct shortcut button on navigation header
modules: Event Management (active event switch, event name, date, watermark logo, mute audio toggle)
Visual Template Editor (canvas grid overlay, add photo slot, coordinates x/y/w/h editor, overlay PNG upload)
Filter Preset Manager (enable/disable filters, preview parameters)

Hardware & Booth Bridge Diagnostics (Camera feed live test, DSLR stub toggle, Printer driver selection [Mock Driver vs Native System Printer], Paper count reset gauge, Bridge WebSocket ping indicator)
Live Stats Counter (Sessions Today, Prints Today, Paper Remaining %, Avg Session Duration)
Gallery & Session History (search by token/time, thumbnail grid, batch download ZIP)

guest_gallery.name: Surface C: Public Mobile Guest Gallery (/g/{token})
ux_constraints: No authentication required — completely public per token link
Ultra-fast loading with smooth image zoom modal and high contrast download buttons
Native Web Share API button + direct Download Single/All as ZIP buttons
Event branding header banner with host congratulations message

visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: backdrop-blur-xl bg-slate-900/75 border border-white/10 shadow-2xl rounded-2xl
visual_enhancers.shutter_flash: fixed inset-0 bg-white z-[100] animate-flash pointer-events-none
visual_enhancers.kiosk_touch_feedback: active:scale-95 hover:scale-[1.02] transition-transform duration-150 ease-out cursor-pointer select-none

sounds.shutter_click: Realistic camera shutter audio sample / click wave
sounds.success_chime: Upbeat chord chime on photo finish / print queue

hardware_stub_specs.camera: Webcam browser API (navigator.mediaDevices.getUserMedia) with fallback Mock DSLR Stub (simulates high-res 24MP frame grab + flash lag)
hardware_stub_specs.printer: PrinterDriver interface abstraction supporting Mock Printer Driver (queues job with progress bar, logs to DB, decrements paper supply count) and System Print Stub

test_attributes.convention: kebab-case, role-based, unique data-testid on every interactive element and data readout

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure all components use standard .jsx / .js React files matching CRA / Craco structure.
Do not use universal CSS transitions like transition: all; always specify opacity, transform, background-color.
Use Lucide icons (lucide-react) for UI icons (e.g. Camera, Printer, QrCode, RefreshCw, Settings, Sparkles, Volume2, VolumeX, Shield, LayoutGrid).
Use Sonner for admin toast notifications.
Maintain strict touch target minimums (min 64px x 64px clickable area) for all guest-facing Kiosk buttons.
Always set explicit hover and focus text colors (e.g., hover:bg-rose-600 hover:text-white).
All key interactive elements MUST include explicit data-testid attributes.
